name: Write code for various video and board games
description: Users requested the creation of code, scripts, or detailed implementation guides for a wide variety of video, board, or card games across different programming languages and platforms. The requests ranged from simple logic-based text games to complex 3D shooters, RPGs, and modding scripts for existing engines or titles.
